Debt grew +1.9bn in FY26 and kept growing in Q1 to fund the engine-parts capex surge (FY26 capex 6.09bn vs D&A 1.79bn). item2_q1_seasonality.finding: 6.2% is INSIDE the historical Q1 band. Weak Q1s are SEASONAL-NORMAL for Yasunaga: FY2023 closed a 20x Q1-annualization gap; FY2025 had a NEGATIVE Q1 and still printed +758M FY. The '4x annualized gap no Q-shape closes' framing is refuted by the company's own history — profits are structurally H2-weighted.

item3_ordinary_to_net_bridge.finding: The 116M drag is ~ALL TAX: current tax 167M against 119M consolidated pre-tax (95% effective rate) — the classic mixed-profitability-group asymmetry (profitable entities pay full current tax; loss-side entities generate no recognized offset), partially softened by -53M deferred. NCI is ZERO. NOT a one-off charge and NOT hidden damage — but also NOT non-recurring: it persists while parts-side losses persist, so trough NET understates trough OP by construction. This is red's one-sided-DTA theme confirmed at the Q1 layer.
